title: Enhanced Glow Lichen
description: Now you can see whether those are diamonds or not...
body:
**Enhanced Glow Lichen** is a resource pack designed to improve the look of the often annoying glow lichen texture in the game. It enhances its appearance, making it more visually appealing and less distracting. 

_This resource pack makes the texture for glow lichen grayer and animated. Looks best without Fullbright._
